'''ELECTRICITY (feat. Lil Uzi Vert)''' (Japanese: '''ELECTRICITY featuring Lil Uzi Vert''') is one of the ending themes for the movie {{DetPikMov}}. The song was performed by {{wp|Honest Boyz|HONEST BOYZ®}} featuring {{wp|Lil Uzi Vert}} and produced by {{wp|Pharrell Williams}}.

On April 19, 2019, the song was announced for release by a "major overseas label".<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20190716034908/https://www.ldh.co.jp/eng/news/detail.php?lang=eng&site=LDH&newsid=0000019142 HONEST BOYZ®'s new song "ELECTRICITY featuring Lil Uzi Vert" selected as the ending song of Hollywood's live-action movie "POKÉMON Detective Pikachu"! | LDH News (archived)]</ref> However, the song was never released, and the announcement has since been taken down.
